name: @dreamteamer/code
description: Run the Dreamteamer browser editor over local files, with a Claude coordinator and authenticated loopback access.

dreamteamer.title: Code
dreamteamer.description: dt editor starts code-server over the existing workspace without Docker. The authenticated URL listens only on IPv4 loopback. A Claude coordinator receives cross-session messages and uses scoped MCP tools to navigate the data app; files stay on the host and processes run as the current user.
